decision: raw273 is the counting historical authority moved active->setAside; raw274 is a non-counting identity lineage to the same authority. Current first-party LODMI proves CPO operation and app-based real-time tariff display, but no anonymous deterministic public numeric direct-tariff grid/resolver was recovered in this run; no third-party tariff is promoted.

evidence.fact: NORMATECH organization description identifies NORMATECH LODMI as an electric-mobility services operator.
LODMI states it is a charge-point operator and manages/refactors charging via MOBIGEST.
LODMI app exposes station tariffs in real time, but the public page does not expose an anonymous numeric tariff grid.
